desc: Implement and host-test the no-media fallback contract in m1n1: U-Boot writes a versioned, checksummed, one-shot reason cookie in an explicitly reserved normal-RAM range and requests only the permitted smc_reboot; the next enrolled m1n1 validates and clears it before payload selection, prints Running proxy..., and enters uartproxy. Grounding: ROADMAP §A/B, NEXT_STEPS §0's always-proxy recovery rule, evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-enrolled-payload-rootcause.md's observed warm-RAM survival, and ticket 3010. Deliver m1n1/U-Boot headers, linker/DT reservation proof, cold/default/corrupt/replay unit tests, and fail-open-to-early-DTR recovery semantics. No NVRAM, PMU, charger, firmware, SPMI, rig, or claim that direct U-Boot return is supported.
author: sol
